# viettelcloud_project_member_roles (Resource)

Manage the complete set of IAM roles of an existing project member. The resource owns the member's whole role set: creating it replaces every role the member holds, including roles assigned outside Terraform, and every later plan proposes removing any role assigned outside Terraform. Destroying it removes every role of the member, keeps the member in the project, and leaves the member's project admin flag unchanged. Manage the roles of one member in one place only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Owns every role of the member "alice". Roles assigned to alice outside
# Terraform are removed on the next apply.
resource "viettelcloud_project_member_roles" "example" {
  member = {
    username = "alice"
  }

  roles = [
    # enabled defaults to true.
    { role = { urn = "urn:role:prj-example:deployer" } },
    # Keep the role assigned without granting its permissions.
    { role = { urn = "urn:role:prj-example:auditor" }, enabled = false },
  ]
}

# Remove every role of the member "bob" while keeping bob in the project.
resource "viettelcloud_project_member_roles" "no_roles" {
  member = {
    username = "bob"
  }

  roles = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `member` (Attributes) Existing human member of the project whose roles the resource manages. Changing the member removes every role of the previous member and replaces the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--member))
- `roles` (Attributes Set) Complete set of role assignments of the member, at most 100. Each role may appear once. Roles not listed are removed from the member; set it to [] to remove every role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

### Read-Only

- `assignments` (Attributes List) Role assignments reported by the backend, sorted by URN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--assignments))
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the member joined the project (RFC3339).
- `id` (String) Project member ID (UUID). This is the import ID.
- `member_email` (String) Email of the member. It can be empty.
- `member_is_admin` (Boolean) Whether the member is a project admin. A project admin holds every permission, so its roles grant nothing more.
- `member_user_id` (String) User ID (UUID) of the member.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the member was last updated (RFC3339). Role changes alone do not change it.

<a id="nestedatt--member"></a>
### Nested Schema for `member`

Required:

- `username` (String) Username of the member. Outer whitespace is ignored; the rest must match exactly, including case.


<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Required:

- `role` (Attributes) Predefined role, or custom role of this project, to assign. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles--role))

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the assignment grants the role's permissions. Defaults to true; set it to false to keep the role assigned without granting it.

<a id="nestedatt--roles--role"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles.role`

Required:

- `urn` (String) URN of the role.



<a id="nestedatt--assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `assignments`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the role.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the role.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the assignment is enabled.
- `id` (String) Assignment ID (UUID). It stays the same while the role remains assigned.
- `role_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the role itself is enabled. A disabled role grants nothing even when the assignment is enabled.
- `type` (String) Role type: predefined or custom.
- `urn` (String) URN of the role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import viettelcloud_project_member_roles.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001
```
